modelStereotypes.name: GraphRagEntity
modelStereotypes.description: Graph-RAG settings of a class: match strategy, relevance anchor, extraction hints and group.

stereotypeProperties.name: graphRagMatch
stereotypeProperties.description: exact | fuzzy: how an extracted instance is matched to existing entities

stereotypeProperties.name: graphRagFuzzyThreshold
stereotypeProperties.description: Score (0-1) at or above which a fuzzy match merges automatically; empty = 0.92

stereotypeProperties.name: graphRagReviewBand
stereotypeProperties.description: Score (0-1) at or above which, below the threshold, a pair goes to review; empty = 0.75

stereotypeProperties.name: graphRagAnchor
stereotypeProperties.description: auto | true | false: whether the relevance gate uses this class; auto = when identified

stereotypeProperties.name: graphRagExtractionHints
stereotypeProperties.description: Free text appended to the extraction prompt: labels, formats, where values appear

stereotypeProperties.name: graphRagGroup
stereotypeProperties.description: Extraction group; empty = the class's domain

modelStereotypes.name: GraphRagIdentity
modelStereotypes.description: The attribute is part of the class's identity key.

stereotypeProperties.name: graphRagIdentityOrder
stereotypeProperties.description: Position in a composite identity key (1-based); empty = declaration order

stereotypeProperties.name: graphRagNormalise
stereotypeProperties.description: trim | casefold | digits | date | amount | none; empty = the default of the type

modelStereotypes.name: GraphRagEmbed
modelStereotypes.description: The String attribute is indexed on its own in the vector store.

classes.name: Customer
classes.description: A company or person invoiced by the organisation. Identified by its SIRET when French, otherwise by name.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Legal name as printed on the document (raison sociale)

attributes.name: siret
attributes.description: French company identifier, 14 digits (SIRET); may be printed with spaces

stereotypePropertyInstances.valueAsString: The SIRET is a 14-digit number, often printed with spaces (123 456 789 00012) in the header or footer. 'Client', 'Facturé à', 'Bill to' introduce the customer block.

classes.name: Contract
classes.description: A framework or service contract that invoices may reference.

attributes.name: scope
attributes.description: Description of the services covered (free text, may be long)

relations.name: customer
relations.description: The customer party of the contract

stereotypePropertyInstances.valueAsString: Contract references look like CT-<digits>. When an invoice only mentions the reference, extract the Contract with its number only.

classes.name: InvoiceLine
classes.description: One line of an invoice: a labelled quantity at a unit price. Value object owned by its invoice.

attributes.name: label
attributes.description: Description of the item or service

stereotypePropertyInstances.valueAsString: One entity per table row of the lines table: Désignation / Quantité / Prix unitaire HT / Montant HT.

classes.name: Invoice
classes.description: An invoice issued to a customer, with its lines, totals, status and optional contract reference.

attributes.name: number
attributes.description: Invoice number as printed (numéro de facture)

relations.name: contract
relations.description: The contract this invoice is issued under, when referenced

stereotypePropertyInstances.valueAsString: French invoices print 'Facture n°', 'Date', 'Échéance', 'Total HT', 'TVA', 'Total TTC'. Amounts use a comma decimal separator and a space thousands separator (1 234,56 €). A line 'Contrat : CT-77' or 'Réf. contrat' references the contract.
